title: Recipe 32 — Local Models (one line of YAML, no key, no cloud)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Air-gapped, or just tired of paying per token — this recipe changes one line of YAML and nothing else.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — on purpose, so the keyless beat later has a real key to scrub.

verify.note: operator-supplied demos/.env; nothing in this drive needs it

beats.label: Parse a local model string
beats.cue: “local/<model>@<base-url> — and the router hands it to the OpenAI adapter with the baseUrl overridden in flight.”
beats.command: bun -e 'import { parseModelString } from "@crewhaus/model-router"; for (const s of ["local/llama3.2@http://localhost:11434/v1", "local/llama3.2"]) console.log(s, "→", JSON.stringify(parseModelString(s)));'

verify.note: prints the recipe's own parse output: providerId openai, baseUrl http://localhost:11434/v1, localUrl true — and the bare form resolves to the same Ollama default

beats.label: Parse a hosted OpenAI-compatible id
beats.cue: “Same adapter, someone else's GPU — and its own key env var, so hosts never fight over OPENAI_API_KEY.”
beats.command: bun -e 'import { parseModelString } from "@crewhaus/model-router"; for (const s of ["groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile", "deepseek/deepseek-chat"]) console.log(s, "→", JSON.stringify(parseModelString(s)));'

beats.label: Type the recipe's tool-use test spec
beats.cue: “Nine lines. The only local-specific byte in the whole file is the model string.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “A local model id is a first-class model id — the linter has no special case for it.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The URL rides through lowering untouched — it is parsed once at runtime, not per turn.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli with agent.model = local/llama3.2@http://localhost:11434/v1

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it. GREEN — and note what it did NOT say: no credentials gate.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot ok (booted and exited cleanly). A local/ model reaches no credential gate at all

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “Same bundle recipe 01 emits. The provider switch happened in the router, not in your code.”

beats.label: Boot it with the keys scrubbed
beats.cue: “Anthropic key unset, OPENAI_API_KEY empty, and it still comes up: the adapter sends the literal string "local" as the bearer token.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY="" bun live/dist/agent.ts < /dev/null

verify.note: prints “agent ready (model: local/llama3.2@http://localhost:11434/v1) [openai]” then exits 0 at EOF — the recipe's `OPENAI_API_KEY=""` claim, executed. Scrubs explicitly because the Setup group sourced .env into this same shell

beats.label: Launch the REPL against Ollama
beats.cue: [manual] “ollama serve on 11434 in the other pane — now the same spec is a live chat loop.”

verify.note: needs a local OpenAI-compatible server (ollama serve + ollama pull llama3.2) on 11434

beats.label: Let the spec run its tool-use test
beats.cue: [manual] “Watch for the tool call itself — that is what this spec exists to measure. A 7B model that cannot emit one is not production-ready.”

verify.note: the driver dir has no README.md, so the Read call returns an error — the thing being tested is whether the local model emits a VALID single tool call at all

groups.title: One more thing · local isn't free, it's unpriced

beats.label: Show the pricing miss
beats.cue: “No row in the pricing table matches llama3.2 — so the tracker charges zero and counts a miss. Zero dollars is not the same as free.”
beats.command: bun -e 'import { TraceEventBus } from "@crewhaus/trace-event-bus"; import { createCostTracker } from "@crewhaus/cost-tracker"; const bus = new TraceEventBus({ runId: "run_local_0001", sessionId: "sess_local_0001" }); const t = createCostTracker(bus); bus.publish({ ...bus.envelope(), kind: "model_response", model: "llama3.2", provider: "openai", stopReason: "end_turn", usage: { input: 4000, output: 600 }, durationMs: 100 }); console.log("pricingMisses:", t.pricingMisses(), "· charged micros:", t.getRunCost("run_local_0001").totalUsdMicros);'

verify.note: prints “pricingMisses: 1 · charged micros: 0” — the miss counter is how you notice an unpriced model

beats.label: Open a bus to watch
beats.cue: “Two lines of harness, so the recipe's override snippet has something to publish into.”
beats.text:
import { TraceEventBus } from "@crewhaus/trace-event-bus";

const bus = new TraceEventBus({ runId: "run_local_0002", sessionId: "sess_local_0002" });

beats.label: Type the recipe's pricing override
beats.cue: “Impute a price for your own electricity: local/* responses report under the openai provider, keyed by the bare model id.”

beats.label: Publish the same response again
beats.cue: “Identical event, identical model string — only the pricing table changed.”

beats.label: Run it
beats.cue: “Zero misses, 520 microdollars: 4000 in at $0.10 per million, 600 out at $0.20. Now your GPU shows up on the same bill as Anthropic.”

verify.note: prints “pricingMisses: 0 · charged micros: 520” — the override turns the miss into an attributed spend
